name: Pentaceratops
group: Animals > Dinosaurs > Land grazers > Horned and frilled dinosaurs

features.claim: It had a short nose horn that pointed upward and backward.
features.quote: The nose horn of Pentaceratops is small and points upward and backward.

features.claim: It had two very long brow horns that curved strongly forward.
features.quote: The brow horns are very long and curve strongly forward.

features.claim: It had long horns on the jugal bones, sticking out sideways under its eyes.
features.quote: It had a short nose horn, two long brow horns, and long horns on the jugal bones.

features.claim: Its skull had a very long frill with triangular hornlets along the edge.
features.quote: Its skull had a very long frill with triangular hornlets on the edge.

features.claim: The frill was somewhat tilted upward and had two large holes in it.
features.quote: The somewhat upward tilted frill of Pentaceratops is considerably longer than that of Triceratops, with two large holes (parietal fenestrae) in it.

features.claim: The frill was rectangular and decorated with large triangular bony bumps, biggest at the rear corners.
features.quote: It is rectangular, adorned by large triangular osteoderms: up to twelve episquamosals at the squamosal and three epiparietals at the parietal bone.

features.claim: The frill had a large U-shaped notch at the middle of its back edge.
features.quote: These are largest at the rear corners of the frill, and are separated by a large U-shaped notch at the midline, a feature not recognized until 1981 when specimen UKVP 16100 was described.

features.claim: Its torso was tall and wide.
features.quote: The torso of Pentaceratops is tall and wide.

features.claim: Its skull was huge, over two meters long.
features.quote: The skull length of AMNH 1624 is 2.3 meters (7.5 ft) while PMU R.200 has a length of 2.16 meters (7.1 ft).

second_reading.claim: Pentaceratops was a large dinosaur with four legs and a horned, frilled head, about 5.5 to 6 meters long.
second_reading.quote: Pentaceratops was about 5.5–6 meters (18–20 ft) long, and has been estimated to have weighed around 2.5 metric tons (2.8 short tons).
second_reading.why: the sentence does not support it

second_reading.claim: It had a long, sharp beak for biting off branches.
second_reading.quote: It would have used its sharp ceratopsian beak to bite off the branches which were then shredded - leaves, needles, and all - by the tooth batteries, providing a self-sharpening continuous cutting edge in both upper and lower jaws.
second_reading.why: the sentence does not support it

second_reading.claim: One source says it was almost 11 meters long and 4 meters tall, while another says it was about 5.5 to 6 meters long.
second_reading.quote: It was almost 11 meters in length and 4 meters tall.
second_reading.why: the sentence does not support it
